page_title: WOL 2-0 AST | Wolves v Aston Villa 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Andy Madley is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.

90+7' 2 - 0 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Emiliano Martinez had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
90+5' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+3' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) took the corner.
90+2' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:3.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
88' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde did his best and is replaced by Santiago Bueno (Wolves).
86' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Lamare Bogarde and he is replaced by Kosta Nedeljkovic (Aston Villa).
81' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) picks up an injury.
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolves.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) for Pablo Sarabia.
78' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
76' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' Here's the change. Rayan Ait-Nouri leaves the pitch and Thomas Doyle (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.
73' Here is a change. Goncalo Guedes is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
68' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
66' Aston Villa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
65' Ball possession – 39:61.
63' Wolves are ruled offside.
59' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Aston Villa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
56' Celebrations are cut short for Aston Villa as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
55' The Aston Villa players joy may have been justified, because referee Andy Madley is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
54' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
53' Referee Andy Madley halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Vitor Pereira, then shows him a yellow.
50' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Unai Emery makes a switch. Ian Maatsen is coming on in place of Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) at the start of the second period.
46' Unai Emery has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) comes on the pitch for Jacob Ramsey.
46' Unai Emery makes a half-time substitution. Leon Bailey comes on in place of Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa).
46' Half-time substitution. Unai Emery decided to make a change. Andres Garcia (Aston Villa) is replaced by Donyell Malen.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' A corner kick by Wolves is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
45+4' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolves will take a corner.

45+4' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Emiliano Martinez. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolves.
45+2' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

44' That was close by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
42' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Wolves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' Looks like Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
38' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) steps up to send the ball in.
37' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.
36' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
36' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Emiliano Martinez easily deals with the threat.
35' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
30' Yellow card. Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
29' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
26' Neat passing move from Aston Villa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Wolves fail to score from a corner as Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.
23' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolves.
21' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
21' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolves.
19' Aston Villa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
16' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
15' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
14' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

12' 1 - 0 Goal! Pablo Sarabia slips a clever pass through to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
10' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
10' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) tested Jose Sa with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
8' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) commits a foul and Andy Madley immediately signals a free kick.
7' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
5' Foul! Matt Doherty (Wolves) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
4' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Wolves will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Andy Madley.
